summary.text: Austin Martin is the Libertarian candidate for the Hawaii House of Representatives, District 3, in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging Democratic incumbent Chris Todd.
Also known as Shiloh, he is chair of the Libertarian Party of Hawaii.

paragraphs.text: Austin Martin attended Abilene Christian University and, as of his 2024 campaign, was chairman of the Libertarian Party of Hawaii.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he said he represents the organic homesteading community of the Big Island and has played music on the streets and served people in need.
Martin ran in the 2024 general election for Hawaii House of Representatives District 3, in which Democratic incumbent Chris Todd defeated him and Kanoa Wilson.
He advanced from the Libertarian Party primary on August 8, 2026.

In the 2024 survey, he listed among his key messages nullifying the Jones Act's effects on Hawaii through a proposal to designate a Hawaiian Homelands port as a non-U.S. port, and confronting public corruption in state government.
